Cluster-FDR with RFT or Permutation P-values

Source: R/cluster_fdr.R
cluster_fdr.Rd

Controls the False Discovery Rate at the cluster level by applying the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure to cluster-extent p-values.

Usage

cluster_fdr(
  stat_vol,
  mask = NULL,
  q = 0.05,
  tail = c("pos", "neg", "two"),
  cluster_thresh = 3,
  p_method = c("rft", "perm"),
  smoothness = NULL,
  null_spec = NULL,
  n_perm = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  fwhm_mm = NULL,
  null_fun = NULL,
  allow_voxel_signflip = FALSE,
  two_sided_policy = c("BH_all", "split_q")
)

Arguments

stat_vol

3D Z-equivalent statistic map (array or NeuroVol).

mask

Optional logical 3D mask. Defaults to finite voxels in stat_vol.

q

FDR level (default 0.05).

tail

One of "pos", "neg", "two". For "two", both tails are pooled into a single BH ordering.

cluster_thresh

Cluster-forming threshold (Z-score).

p_method

Method for computing cluster p-values: "rft" (Random Field Theory) or "perm" (permutation).

smoothness

A smoothness_fwhm() (or numeric mm) — required when p_method = "rft". Ignored otherwise.

null_spec

A null_spec supplying null draws — required when p_method = "perm".

n_perm

Number of permutations to consume from null_spec. Defaults to null_spec$n_perm.

seed

Optional random seed.

fwhm_mm

Deprecated alias for smoothness.

null_fun

Deprecated bare-function null source; prefer null_spec.

allow_voxel_signflip

Deprecated; if TRUE and null_spec/null_fun are missing, falls back to independent voxel sign-flips.

two_sided_policy

Deprecated. The "two" tail now uses BH on the pooled set of clusters (the previous "BH_all" behaviour). Pass "split_q" only if you need the legacy q/2 split per tail.

Value

A neurothresh_result with method = "cluster_fdr" and the cluster table in $clusters. $threshold is cluster_thresh.

References

Chumbley & Friston (2009), NeuroImage 44(1), 62-70.

See also

rft_cluster_fwer(), tfce_fwer(), hier_scan().
